findings.problem: The `comm₃` field of `triangleOfSES.map` reproves the naturality of the connecting morphism. The goal is `triangleOfSESδ h₁ ≫ (Q.map f.τ₁)⟦1⟧' = Q.map f.τ₃ ≫ triangleOfSESδ h₂`, and this is exactly `triangleOfSESδ_naturality`, proved earlier in the same file (lines 53–66). Both proofs unfold `triangleOfSESδ` and move `inv (Q.map (descShortComplex _))` across the equation using `IsIso.inv_comp_eq`. Both then use naturality of `commShiftIso` and `descShortComplex`, and both finish with `(mappingCone.triangleMap S₁.f S₂.f f.τ₁ f.τ₂ f.comm₁₂.symm).comm₃`. The same mapping-cone and derived-category argument is therefore maintained twice, in two different styles. Nothing in this file uses `triangleOfSESδ_naturality`, so the lemma is currently dead weight here.
findings.proposed_change:
Make `comm₃` a use of the existing lemma. It is available because it is declared before `section map`, and the hypotheses `h₁ h₂ f` match `hS₁ hS₂ f`:
```
  comm₃ := by
    simpa [triangleOfSES] using triangleOfSESδ_naturality h₁ h₂ f
```
A plain `exact triangleOfSESδ_naturality h₁ h₂ f` may also work, because `Triangle.mk` projections unfold definitionally. This removes the 7-line duplicate proof and the `set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in` line, if that option is no longer needed.
findings.benefit: The mapping-cone calculation lives in one place, `triangleOfSESδ_naturality`. `triangleOfSES.map` becomes a short assembly of `comm₁`, `comm₂` and the named lemma, and later changes to `triangleOfSESδ` need only one proof fixed. The lemma is also exercised inside the file rather than only from Ext/Map.lean.
